short_question_protocol.base_observations: Unchanged v8-focused prompt with independent questions appended after inference.
short_question_protocol.early_stop: A no or unknown answer stops the remaining questions for that window.
short_question_protocol.acceptance: All four answers must say yes with at least two common consecutive supporting frames, no gap over 2.1 seconds, and at least two earlier frames supporting bag presence.
short_question_protocol.inputs: Uniform sweep over actual sampled source frames; no video identities, organizer labels, manual event times or per-video zones enter the questions.
short_question_protocol.source_kind: Development case scenario, not a statutory requirement.

verdict.denominator: Completed unique sources only; failures and missing inputs are reported separately.

timing_error_sec.ambiguous_policy: Different timestamps on byte-identical copies are inconsistent annotations, not two confirmed events; exclude the entire source from headline timing.
timing_error_sec.method: Nearest actual finding to the sole organizer timestamp; only correctly detected unique positive sources with one unambiguous label. This is not one-to-one event matching and may favour videos with more findings.

latency_sec.scope: Actual per-video analyze wall time; warm model preparation measured separately; cache retrieval not counted.

limitations: The same eight development-validation sources were used repeatedly to design and compare prompts; this is not an independent final accuracy estimate.
The candidate adds the scenario-based V-BAG-UNATTENDED rule alongside the question protocol; the verdict comparison is not a prompt-only ablation with an unchanged rule catalog.

The bag scenario comes from the organizer's positive label and the user's factual clarification. It does not establish a specific statutory violation, hidden contents, internal storage rules or off-camera responsibility transfer.
No ambiguous development examples or user descriptions were added to training, and the fixed training/validation partition was preserved.
Single-question and per-frame-position probes were not reliable enough alone; the production candidate uses the joint short-window protocol only.
No additional long-video latency optimization was performed.

remaining_positive_misses.rule_basis: Organizer violation type remains unspecified; observed cash states alone do not establish a violation.
Organizer violation type remains unspecified; coffee or visible cash alone was not assigned a new violation rule.
